_comment: Not a Joomla extension — no extension/build/manifests block, unlike every other cwm-build-tools consumer. The archive is content/manifest.json + content/images/, zipped directly (see README). ars.categoryId and ars.updateStreamId are placeholders: no 'Demo Content' category exists yet, and plg_webservices_ars has no creation API for either — both need creating via the ARS admin UI (System -> Manage -> Akeeba Release System) before cwm-ars-publish can be used here. Fill in the real ids once created.
